$comment: P35.37 (SIG-TRANSP-013, J3 §5.4): the manifest-listed artifact paths a figure's data-artifact may name. In fixtures mode this committed list IS the manifest the pointer check verifies against (the fixture-export harness serialises the same paths into the manifest it writes); in SIG_DATA_SOURCE=export mode the check verifies against the real export manifest and REFUSES any path the manifest does not list. Compartment-keyed row streams (sites/statements/record_claims .jsonl) are matched by a pattern in figures.ts, not enumerated here. Every entry is a build artifact path relative to the export root — never a page route.
